interface.name: zcosmic_toplevel_info_v1
interface.description: The purpose of this protocol is to enable clients such as taskbars or docks to access a list of opened applications and basic properties thereof.

event.name: toplevel
event.description:
This event is emitted for clients binding version 1 whenever a new toplevel window is created. It is emitted for all toplevels, regardless of the app that has created them.
All initial properties of the toplevel (title, app_id, states, etc.) will be sent immediately after this event via the corresponding events in zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1.

request.name: stop
request.description: This request indicates that the client no longer wishes to receive events for new toplevels.

event.name: finished

description.summary: the compositor has finished with the toplevel manager

event.description: This event indicates that the compositor is done sending events to the zcosmic_toplevel_info_v1.

request.name: get_cosmic_toplevel
request.description: Request a zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1 extension object for an existing ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1. All initial properties of the toplevel (states, etc.) will be sent immediately via the corresponding events in zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1.

event.name: done

description.summary: all information about active toplevels have been sent

event.description: This event is sent after all changes for currently active zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1 have been sent.

interface.name: zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1
interface.description: A zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1 object represents an open toplevel window. A single app may have multiple open toplevels.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request should be called either when the client will no longer use the zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1.

event.name: closed
event.description: The server will emit no further events on the zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1 after this event.

event.name: done

description.summary: all information about the toplevel has been sent

event.description: This event is sent after all changes in the toplevel state have been sent.

event.name: title
event.description: This event is emitted whenever the title of the toplevel changes.

event.name: app_id
event.description: This event is emitted whenever the app_id of the toplevel changes.

event.name: output_enter
event.description: This event is emitted whenever the toplevel becomes visible on the given output. A toplevel may be visible on multiple outputs.

event.name: output_leave
event.description: This event is emitted whenever the toplevel is no longer visible on a given output.

enum.name: state

description.summary: types of states on the toplevel

enum.description: The different states that a toplevel may have. These have the same meaning as the states with the same names defined in xdg-toplevel

event.name: state
event.description: This event is emitted once on creation of the zcosmic_toplevel_handle_v1 and again whenever the state of the toplevel changes.

event.name: geometry

description.summary: the toplevel's position and/or size has changed

event.description: Emitted when the geometry of a toplevel relative to the provided output has changed.

arg.name: x
arg.summary: x coordinate of the upper-left corner

arg.name: y
arg.summary: y coordinate of the upper-left corner
